kurzfassung: Glenn examines why digital and parasocial interactions fail to satisfy human needs for genuine friendship and connection. Salena Zito analyzes the latest evidence and conspiracy theories surrounding the assassination attempt against President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania. stichpunkte: Whether digital and parasocial interactions fulfill human needs for true connection
An analysis of the loneliness epidemic in America
Latest evidence from the investigation into the assassination attempt against President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania
The proliferation of conspiracy theories surrounding the assassination attempt
The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence outpacing current safety safeguards
beschreibung:
Is there a loneliness epidemic in America? Despite being able to connect to more people than ever before, Glenn explains how digital and parasocial connections don’t satisfy the human need for true connection and friendship. The more that comes out about the assassination attempt against President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, the more conspiracy theories we have. Glenn speaks with Washington Examiner national political reporter Salena Zito, who breaks down the latest evidence from the investigation. Center for Humane Technology co-founder Tristan Harris joins to discuss the troubling truth that AI is advancing faster than our safeguards.
